text:
maria: kicking off AP-NORTHEAST-1 cluster bootstrap pipeline (region-bootstrap/apn1). primary goals: mirror images to s3-backed registry mirror, run GitOps/Helm apply with post-renderer to inject node affinity and cost tags, run preflight smoke tests. need a short preflight checklist.

devops-bot: pipeline triggered: region-bootstrap/apn1 #202 by maria. logs: https://ci.internal/r/202 :eyes:

ben: quick q — are we cosign-signing images before we mirror? we should pin digests in helm values (no floating tags). also multi-arch manifests need to be preserved.

ashley: prereqs checklist: VPC peering + route tables, NAT gateway for image pull egress, replication role in registry (replicator@infra), KMS key enabled for registry encryption, egress budget set (start with 2TB/mo and monitor).

kai: GPU pool notes: label nodes with gpu.type=a100 or gpu.type=h100 and taints gpu=true:NoSchedule. helm values for GPU pool sample:

```
gpuPools:
  - name: gpu-a100
    labels:
      gpu.type: a100
    tolerations:
      - key: "gpu"
        operator: "Equal"
        value: "true"
        effect: "NoSchedule"
    autoscaling:
      min: 0
      max: 50
```

also ensure cluster quotas for accelerators are pre-approved with cloud quotas team.

oliver: quick dry-run commands for the mirror + helm post-renderer (run from infra CI runner):

```
# mirror images to s3-registry and record digests
registry-mirror sync --src docker.io/redwood/model:1.2.0 --dst s3://mirrors/apn1/ --sign-with cosign
cosign sign --key ksm://projects/infrakms/key model@sha256:...

# helm dry-run with post-renderer that injects nodeAffinity and cost tags
helm upgrade --install inference redwood/inference -f values-apn1.yaml --post-renderer ./inject-affinity.sh --dry-run
``` 

maria: good, I'll add cosign step into the pipeline and require digest pinning in the Helm release steps. who can validate the registry lifecycle policy (retention/prune) for mirrors?

ben: I'll take registry lifecycle. also will run `cosign verify` after the first mirror completes.

devops-bot: pipeline status: completed_with_warnings. 1 image failed checksum verification during mirror. details: https://ci.internal/r/202/logs/step-mirror

ashley: action: rerun mirror with --checksum and enable retries (3). If still failing, pull the image to a scratch node and inspect layers. After mirror, run smoke test:

```
# smoke test
kubectl -n inference run smoke --image=mirrors.apn1/redwood/smoke:latest --restart=Never --rm -it -- /bin/sh -c "curl -sS http://inference-public.healthz | grep OK"
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/inference-server
```

kai: add prom scrape annotations to helm values and tag resources with cost-center=infra and region=ap-northeast-1 so billing pipeline picks up usage.

maria: plan: 1) fix failing image (ben + ashley), 2) rerun mirror, 3) run helm post-renderer dry-run and apply, 4) handoff to oncall for smoke test tomorrow 01:00 UTC. tagging this for follow-up: @ben @ashley @kai :thumbsup:

ben: noted. I'll start with cosign verify now and report back.

devops-bot: reminder scheduled: region-bootstrap/apn1 handoff checklist deploy at 01:00 UTC — created incident task IT-789.

oliver: added a tiny helper in infra-scripts/verify-mirror.sh to fetch manifest lists and test digests quickly. will open MR with README.

maria: thanks all — keeping thread open until handoff complete. will update with final run id and links.
